**Power-law fit, innov:** gain = 0.165 * mu^0.36  (log-space R^2 = 0.63, 12 configurations).

**voi_fb:** gain is not positive in enough configurations to fit a law (mean gain -0.4%).

**Predictor comparison for voi_psa gain (log-space R^2):** mean mismatch mu: 0.50; mismatch *variability* nu = acc^2*sqrt(duty(1-duty)): 0.63  [nu was proposed after seeing the data -> exploratory; see confirmatory run]. nu-fit: gain = 0.098 * nu^0.24

**Held-out check (voi_psa):** fit on the 9 mildest configs, predict the 3 strongest: mu=0.091 predicted 7.9% observed 9.5%, mu=0.167 predicted 9.4% observed 7.3%, mu=0.286 predicted 11.0% observed 5.0%

**Null regime (no manoeuvres):** voi_psa vs periodic = +0.10% [-1.31, +1.53]% (equivalent within 1%: False)
